title: A new sport for Paris 2024 2024
titleChinese: 巴黎奥运会新项目：霹雳舞
paragraphs: Have you heard of these dance moves? The lego leg? A clock blender? Helicopter? Don't worry. By the end of the summer, you may know all these words! Paris is preparing to host the Olympic and Paralympic games, and a new sport will be making its debut.

Breaking is also known as breakdancing. The dance sport is characterised by stylised footwork, acrobatic movements and freezing, where the B-boy or B-girl stops all movement, often upside down and balancing on one hand. From power moves like windmills and head spins, breakdancers really push the limits of physicality and creativity.

It was in the streets of the Bronx, New York, in the 1970s that breaking emerged as a revolutionary dance form, deeply rooted in hip-hop culture. It's come a long way from there to the world stage in Paris. Athletes from around the world will showcase their skills in one-on-one battles, where each dancer has 60 seconds to impress the judges with their improvisation and proficiency in six criteria: creativity, versatility, performance skills, personality, technique and musicality.

However, as breaking moves from a lifestyle to a competitive sport, some fear it risks losing its spontaneity and creativity. Thorsten Sufke, President of the Berlin Dance Sport Association, emphasises that breaking is an expression of urban culture, representing the raw energy of the streets, while B-Boy Carl Ferdinand Beccard expresses concerns that the Olympic format may suppress the artistic freedom of breaking, reducing it to a checklist of predefined moves.
Whichever way you look at it, you can expect thrilling dance performances never before seen at an Olympics this summer.

vocabulary.entry: **debut** /ˈdeɪbjuː/ n. 首次亮相，初次登场（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The new model will make its debut at the motor show.
vocabulary.translation: 这款新车型将在车展上首次亮相。

vocabulary.entry: **characterise** /ˈkærəktəraɪz/ v. 以……为特征，描述（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The city is characterised by its beautiful old buildings.
vocabulary.translation: 这座城市以其美丽的老建筑为特色。

vocabulary.entry: **stylised** /ˈstaɪlaɪzd/ adj. 风格化的，程式化的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The dancers performed stylised movements to traditional music.
vocabulary.translation: 舞者们随着传统音乐表演风格化的动作。

vocabulary.entry: **acrobatic** /ˌækrəˈbætɪk/ adj. 杂技的，特技的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The circus performers amazed the crowd with their acrobatic skills.
vocabulary.translation: 马戏团演员用他们的杂技技巧让观众惊叹不已。

vocabulary.entry: **freeze** /friːz/ n. 定格（舞蹈动作）
vocabulary.example: The dancer ended the routine with a dramatic freeze.
vocabulary.translation: 舞者以一个戏剧性的定格动作结束了整套舞蹈。

vocabulary.entry: **physicality** /ˌfɪzɪˈkæləti/ n. 身体性，体能表现（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The sport requires a high level of physicality and endurance.
vocabulary.translation: 这项运动需要高水平的体能和耐力。

vocabulary.entry: **revolutionary** /ˌrevəˈluːʃənəri/ adj. 革命性的，突破性的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The invention was a revolutionary breakthrough in technology.
vocabulary.translation: 这项发明是技术上的革命性突破。

vocabulary.entry: **rooted in** /ˈruːtɪd ɪn/ phr. 根植于，源于（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The tradition is deeply rooted in the local culture.
vocabulary.translation: 这一传统深深植根于当地文化。

vocabulary.entry: **come a long way** /ˌkʌm ə ˈlɒŋ weɪ/ phr. 取得很大进展，进步很大（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Technology has come a long way in the past twenty years.
vocabulary.translation: 科技在过去二十年中取得了长足的进步。

vocabulary.entry: **showcase** /ˈʃəʊkeɪs/ v. 展示，展现（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The exhibition showcases the work of young artists.
vocabulary.translation: 这次展览展示了年轻艺术家的作品。

vocabulary.entry: **one-on-one** /ˌwʌn ɒn ˈwʌn/ adj. 一对一的
vocabulary.example: The students receive one-on-one tuition from experienced teachers.
vocabulary.translation: 学生们接受经验丰富的教师的一对一辅导。

vocabulary.entry: **improvisation** /ˌɪmprəvaɪˈzeɪʃn/ n. 即兴创作，即兴表演（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The actor's improvisation added humour to the scene.
vocabulary.translation: 演员的即兴表演为这场戏增添了幽默。

vocabulary.entry: **proficiency** /prəˈfɪʃnsi/ n. 熟练，精通（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The test measures proficiency in spoken English.
vocabulary.translation: 这项测试衡量英语口语的熟练程度。

vocabulary.entry: **versatility** /ˌvɜːsəˈtɪləti/ n. 多样性，多才多艺（书面语）
vocabulary.example: His versatility as a musician allows him to play many instruments.
vocabulary.translation: 他作为音乐家的多才多艺使他能够演奏多种乐器。

vocabulary.entry: **musicality** /mjuːˈzɪkæləti/ n. 音乐性，乐感（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The dancer's musicality was evident in her perfect timing.
vocabulary.translation: 这位舞者的音乐性在她完美的节奏感中体现得淋漓尽致。

vocabulary.entry: **spontaneity** /ˌspɒntəˈneɪəti/ n. 自发性，即兴性（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The charm of live theatre lies in its spontaneity.
vocabulary.translation: 现场戏剧的魅力在于其即兴性。

vocabulary.entry: **raw energy** /ˌrɔː ˈenədʒi/ n. 原始能量，未经雕琢的活力（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The band's performance was full of raw energy.
vocabulary.translation: 乐队的表演充满了原始的活力。

vocabulary.entry: **suppress** /səˈpres/ v. 压制，抑制（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The government tried to suppress the protest.
vocabulary.translation: 政府试图镇压抗议活动。

vocabulary.entry: **artistic freedom** /ɑːˈtɪstɪk ˈfriːdəm/ n. 艺术自由（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Artistic freedom is essential for creative expression.
vocabulary.translation: 艺术自由对创造性表达至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: **predefined** /ˌpriːdɪˈfaɪnd/ adj. 预先定义的，预设的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The software comes with predefined templates.
vocabulary.translation: 这个软件带有预先定义的模板。

vocabulary.entry: **thrilling** /ˈθrɪlɪŋ/ adj. 激动人心的，扣人心弦的
vocabulary.example: The match had a thrilling finish.
vocabulary.translation: 比赛有一个激动人心的结局。

sentences.english: Have you heard of these dance moves?
sentences.chinese: 你听说过这些舞蹈动作吗？

sentences.english: By the end of the summer, you may know all these words!
sentences.chinese: 到夏天结束时，你可能就会知道所有这些词了！

sentences.english: Paris is preparing to host the Olympic and Paralympic games, and a new sport will be making its debut.
sentences.chinese: 巴黎正在准备主办奥运会和残奥会，一项新的运动将首次亮相。

sentences.english: Breaking is also known as breakdancing.
The dance sport is characterised by stylised footwork, acrobatic movements and freezing, where the B-boy or B-girl stops all movement, often upside down and balancing on one hand.
sentences.chinese: 这项舞蹈运动的特点是风格化的脚步动作、杂技动作和定格，即霹雳舞男孩或女孩停止所有动作，常常是倒立并用一只手保持平衡。

sentences.english: From power moves like windmills and head spins, breakdancers really push the limits of physicality and creativity.
sentences.chinese: 从风车和头转等力量动作来看，霹雳舞者真正突破了体能和创造力的极限。

sentences.english: It was in the streets of the Bronx, New York, in the 1970s that breaking emerged as a revolutionary dance form, deeply rooted in hip-hop culture.
sentences.chinese: 霹雳舞于20世纪70年代在纽约布朗克斯区的街头兴起，成为一种深植于嘻哈文化的颠覆性的舞蹈形式。

sentences.english: It's come a long way from there to the world stage in Paris.
sentences.chinese: 从那里到巴黎的世界舞台，它走过了漫长的道路。

sentences.english: Athletes from around the world will showcase their skills in one-on-one battles, where each dancer has 60 seconds to impress the judges with their improvisation and proficiency in six criteria: creativity, versatility, performance skills, personality, technique and musicality.
sentences.chinese: 来自世界各地的运动员将在一对一的对决中展示他们的技能，每位舞者有60秒的时间，通过在创造力、多样性、表演技巧、个性、技术和音乐性这六个标准的即兴表演和水准来打动评委。

sentences.english: However, as breaking moves from a lifestyle to a competitive sport, some fear it risks losing its spontaneity and creativity.
sentences.chinese: 然而，随着霹雳舞从一种生活方式转变为竞技体育，一些人担心它可能会失去自然性和创造力。

sentences.english: Thorsten Sufke, President of the Berlin Dance Sport Association, emphasises that breaking is an expression of urban culture, representing the raw energy of the streets, while B-Boy Carl Ferdinand Beccard expresses concerns that the Olympic format may suppress the artistic freedom of breaking, reducing it to a checklist of predefined moves.
sentences.chinese: 柏林舞蹈运动协会主席托尔斯滕·苏夫克强调，霹雳舞是城市文化的一种表达，代表着街头原始的能量，而霹雳舞者卡尔·费迪南德·贝卡德则表达了对奥运赛制可能压制霹雳舞艺术自由、将其简化为一份预定动作清单的担忧。

sentences.english: Whichever way you look at it, you can expect thrilling dance performances never before seen at an Olympics this summer.
sentences.chinese: 无论你怎么看，你都可以期待今年夏天在奥运会上看到前所未有的激动人心的舞蹈表演。
